svg.title: The Mosaic: Cork-board collage
svg.desc: The Mosaic (1D): the cork board where six guests' cards hang in a row, places and objects above them, stamped statement slips below. A red thread pulled taut between 402 and 404 has just proved true, and its question card is pinned at the top; a blue dashed thread from 401 to the Bonded House is taut too, while a wrong guess hangs slack. Spools of four thread colours wait on the right.

g.text: Who is he guarding it for?
